title: Roger Goodell: We want the Pro Bowl to be an honor without an exhibition game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Roger Goodell: We want the Pro Bowl to be an honor without an exhibition game
sources.description: The NFL has had more than 100 Pro Bowlers in recent years because of players who were either too injured or disinterested in participating.
